description: An inline comparison of two texts built on Tempo.Blazor.Diff: every change is a real <ins> / <del> pair preceded by a visually hidden label, so the difference is carried by semantics and text rather than by colour alone. Display mode (the default) presents the changes; Review mode adds one decision per change - a marker button that opens a non-modal popover with Accept / Reject (and the A / R shortcuts inside it), bulk Accept all / Reject all, one level of Undo and a two-way AcceptedHunkIds. The component is a controlled component over that set: the host owns it, hears every change through AcceptedHunkIdsChanged and receives the resulting wording through ResultChanged - always the exact TextDiffResult.Apply output. OnDecision runs before a decision is applied; a throw leaves the change undecided and surfaces the localized error. A pathological input degrades to the engine's fallback and says so instead of throwing. Accessibility: the marker is a labelled button (aria-haspopup / aria-expanded / aria-controls), opening the popover moves focus into it and Escape closes it with focus restored to the marker, exactly one polite live region announces every result, and the shortcuts can be turned off and never fire from a repeat or a modified key press.

parameters.name: OldText
parameters.description: The original text; null is read as empty.

parameters.name: NewText
parameters.description: The proposed text; null is read as empty.

parameters.name: Granularity
parameters.description: Comparison granularity. Words (the default) gives one decision per changed word, Lines one per changed line.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: How the comparison is presented. Default is Display.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true, every decision surface is removed even in Review - the diff degrades to the read-only presentation. The effective switch is IsReview.

parameters.name: AcceptedHunkIds
parameters.description: Ids of the accepted CHANGES. The rest are rejected, so null or an empty set means 'nothing accepted yet' and ResultText is the old text.

parameters.name: AcceptedHunkIdsChanged
parameters.description: Raised whenever the accepted set changes through a decision, a bulk action or Undo.

parameters.name: ResultChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the resulting text - the exact TextDiffResult.Apply output for the new accepted set.

parameters.name: OnDecision
parameters.description: Invoked for every change a decision is about to apply. A throw leaves the change undecided and shows the localized error.

parameters.name: EnableShortcuts
parameters.description: Whether the A (accept) and R (reject) shortcuts work inside an open popover. Default true.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: Limits of the comparison; null keeps the engine defaults.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the diff group. Defaults to a localized 'Inline diff'.

methods.name: AcceptHunkAsync
methods.description: Accepts one change: runs OnDecision and applies the decision only when it completes without throwing. A no-op for an unknown id or outside Review mode.

methods.name: RejectHunkAsync
methods.description: Rejects one change. Behaves like AcceptHunkAsync.

methods.name: AcceptAllAsync
methods.description: Accepts every change that is not accepted yet; a throw applies none of them.

methods.name: RejectAllAsync
methods.description: Rejects every change that is still accepted.

methods.name: UndoAsync
methods.description: Restores the accepted set from before the last decision.

examples.title: Review the proposed wording
examples.description: Every change becomes a decision; the host keeps the accepted set and receives the resulting text.
examples.code:
<TmInlineDiff OldText="@original"
              NewText="@proposed"
              Mode="InlineDiffMode.Review"
              AcceptedHunkIds="@accepted"
              AcceptedHunkIdsChanged="@(ids => accepted = ids)"
              ResultChanged="@(text => result = text)"
              OnDecision="@PersistAsync" />

examples.title: Read-only comparison
examples.description: The unchanged default: an inline render of the differences without any decision surface.

notes: AcceptedHunkIds lists the ids of CHANGES only. The unchanged hunks are part of the applied set internally, because the separator between two changes belongs to the hunk before it.

A change above TextDiffOptions.MaxTokens / MaxCells degrades to the engine's fallback (line level, then a single whole-text change) and reports it through the data-fallback attribute and a localized note.
